description: A single advisor-memory fact rendered as a flat glass card with a destructive delete affordance. Replaces the local memoryCard in app/settings/advisor-memory.tsx.

fact.description: The remembered fact text. Rendered in full with no line clamp so the user can read it to decide whether to forget it.

onDelete.description: Called on delete tap; opens the 'Forget this?' destructive confirm Alert, then deleteAdvisorMemory(id) + optimistic removal.

deleting.description: When true, dims the card to 0.5 opacity and disables interaction during the in-flight delete.

deleteButton.label: Forget: {fact}
deleteButton.hint: Removes this from what your advisor remembers

accessibility.reducedMotion: No motion of its own; any press/opacity transition uses animation.fast and honors reduce-motion.

notes: AdvisorMemory type is { id, scope, fact } with no timestamp — do not add a date subtitle. Long facts grow the card vertically; the delete button stays flexShrink:0 and top-aligned.
